the pool section is for the wide server and the component leaves the pool where the engine put it unless iw4x32-pool48 is planted next to iw4x.exe

this table set is built for 64 slots. Past 34 players the in-place clientinfo growth no longer fits the room post_cg_globals vacates, so post_cg_globals reaches over cg_entities (0x8EE4B8..0x9F5CA8) and the two own-body cg_entities sites become dual_operands: base + ours_offset in our layout, base + stock_offset on stock 18-slot servers. cg_s grows in place by 0xEDE8 (46 x 0x52C) to 0x8FD2A0, inside the room post_cg_globals vacates - the set fits up to 66 slots

pool.note: the GSC script-variable pool: one contiguous block of 16-byte scrVar_t entries at pool.base (index 0 = header, 1..parent_cap = the parent pool, child0_base.. = child pool 0, child1_base.. = child pool 1). The engine reaches it by absolute address AND by pool index (index = child0_base + n * child_cap), so growing it means relocating the block and rewriting both kinds of site. address_sites: operand_va holds the old absolute address, new = new block base + offset. constant_sites: operand_va holds an old geometry constant, new = the same geometry in the new block. Every link inside the pool is a 16-bit value (the init writes entry+0 = index - pool's first index, the allocator walks the free list as next = base + (index + word)*16), so NEITHER cap may pass 0x10000.
